mainEntity.name: Is Unlistened.me free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Unlistened.me is completely free. There is no subscription, no ads, and no hidden cost.

mainEntity.name: Do you track my listening activity?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Unlistened.me does not use cookies to track listening habits or personal behavior.

mainEntity.name: Do I need an account to listen to podcasts?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You can browse and listen without an account. A free account is only needed for saved features.

mainEntity.name: How many podcasts are available on Unlistened.me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unlistened.me indexes thousands of podcasts across many categories, including technology, culture, arts, and personal development.

mainEntity.name: Can I listen on mobile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Unlistened.me is responsive and works on modern smartphone and tablet browsers.

mainEntity.name: Who created Unlistened.me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unlistened.me was created by Gianluca Tiengo as an independent project focused on simple and privacy respectful digital products.

mainEntity.name: Is Unlistened.me open source?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unlistened.me is a personal project built with Vue, Vite, and Laravel. Parts of it may be shared over time.

mainEntity.name: How can I contact support?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can write to support@unlistened.me.

mainEntity.name: Does Unlistened.me use cookies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unlistened.me does not use tracking cookies. A session cookie is only used when you choose to log in.

/documentation.title: User guide for Unlistened.me
/documentation.description: Learn how to use Unlistened.me, from discovering podcasts and music to saving favorites, playlists, and bookmarks.

mainEntity.name: Do I need an account to start listening?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You can browse and listen without an account. An account is only needed for saved features such as favorites, bookmarks, and playlists.

mainEntity.name: Where can I save podcasts and episodes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Podcasts can be saved to favorites and episodes can be saved to bookmarks.

mainEntity.name: Does Unlistened.me remember where I stopped listening?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Listening progress is stored so you can resume from where you left off.

mainEntity.name: Can I create playlists for music?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Signed in users can like tracks, create playlists, and organize music into personal collections.

/terms.title: Terms and conditions for Unlistened.me
/terms.description: Read the terms and conditions for Unlistened.me, including content responsibility, trademarks, user information, and service rules.

mainEntity.name: Who is responsible for podcast and music content on Unlistened.me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Creators and rights holders remain responsible for the content made available through the platform.

mainEntity.name: Does Unlistened.me provide warranties about the service?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The service is provided as is and as available.

mainEntity.name: Can the terms change over time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The terms may be updated when necessary.

mainEntity.name: Is Unlistened.me a commercial service?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Unlistened.me is presented as a non profit project.

/privacy.title: Privacy policy for Unlistened.me
/privacy.description: Learn how Unlistened.me collects, uses, and protects your data. Privacy focused listening with clear and simple policies.

mainEntity.name: Does Unlistened.me track my listening activity?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Optional analytics remain disabled until you explicitly accept them.

mainEntity.name: What personal data is stored if I create an account?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you create an account, Unlistened.me stores your name, email address, hashed password, preferences, and saved library items.

mainEntity.name: Can I delete my account and saved data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can delete your account from the Settings page.

mainEntity.name: Are podcast audio files hosted by Unlistened.me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not always. Some podcast covers and audio files are hosted by the podcasts themselves.
